reviews.comment: Assigns 750 word essays each week, on Unit weeks there is an additional 500 word essay. Grades essays harshly. New readings every class, long. Grades attendance and participation (if you don't read good luck on participation points). No final, instead, it is a 2500 word essay/ project. Had an A, final essay dropped me to a low B...Never again.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--So many papers
